name: Old Habits
summary: A burned Dragonmaw book reaches Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor. Its damaged pages mention dragon-binding rituals and the Shadow Council.

sections.title: A Damaged Book
sections.body: You bring Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor a badly burned book that may have survived the dragonfire that ravaged the Dragonmaw clan. Its few legible pages describe rituals involving the Demon Soul, which the clan used to control dragons. The book is incomplete, though Nek’rosh seems to have tried to save it with pages of animal hide and fresh ink naming the Shadow Council.

sections.title: Stoutfist’s Answer
sections.body: Captain Stoutfist says the book should be destroyed, for he will not risk the orcs using it. He fears dragonriders at Menethil Harbor, and the mention of the Shadow Council troubles him. He plans to send word to his superiors.

faq.q: What is in the tattered spellbook?
faq.answer: Its surviving pages describe rituals involving the Demon Soul, which the Dragonmaw clan used to control dragons. Fresh ink also names the Shadow Council.

faq.q: Who tried to save the book?
faq.answer: Nek’rosh seems to have tried to salvage the book by inserting pages made of animal hide.

faq.q: Who wants the book brought to them?
faq.answer: Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor wants to hear about the book.

faq.q: Why is the book hard to read?
faq.answer: The book is badly burned, and little of it remains legible.
